facility.name: The Kids Zone Learning Center

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 5/10 children's records reviewed did not have adequate information for emegency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff person was present at the operation without an active background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have an updated fire inspection that was conducted by a fire marshal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The food allergy plan was not signed by both parent and health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The emergency preparedness plan did not have all required items, including:    746.5202 (B)(D)(E)(3 A,B)(4)(5)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not have documentation of all drills conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Potty-Chairs: A potty seat was observed to not have been sanitized immediately after use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Potty-Chairs (26 TAC §746.3407(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: One vehicle did not have a required first aid kit. Two vehicles did not have all required supplies in good condition.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The emergency preparedness plan did not have all required items, including:    746.5202 (B)(D)(E)(3 A,B)(4)(5)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Required medical information was not available for 28 children in the AM transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The food allergy plan was not signed by both parent and health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care: Electronic child safety alarms were not being used in all vehicles checked during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: 2 caregivers were unaware of how many children they were caring for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Information regarding emergency telephone numbers was not available for 28 children in the AM transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have an updated fire inspection that was condcuted by a fire marshall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Orientation-Handling, storage and disposing of hazardous materials: One caregiver did not have the required orientation traning for handling, storage and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Orientation-Handling, storage and disposing of hazardous materials (26 TAC §746.1303(9))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Proper supervision was not observed when multiple school age children were allowed to go into the building from outside alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Several classrooms had missing outlet covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Cleaning material was founded in sink that were not locked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver left the classroom for approximately 1 minute and 58 seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when the operational policies regarding release procedures of children were not followed, resulting in infants being left unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Seven out of ten children are missing an admission date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One of the four infants do not have updated infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised: The director is not appropriately supervising staff, as a classroom was left unattended for a period of time during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: There was no caregiver supervising nap time for approximately 30 seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Operation is using out dated admission forms from 2010 that does not have a special care needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Staff were not properly supervising children when they were seen walking around the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Operation has a piece of paper taped to an epi-pen. The Epi-pen is not in it's original packaging.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation did not immediately communicate to the parents' critical information regarding an incident that placed a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: The driver of the vehicle did not conduct a name to face when the children got of the vehicle, which resulted in a child being left on a vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: A child was left unattended in a vehicle for approximately 40 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not share an incident report with the parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report to Child Care Regulation that a child was left on a vehicle, back in September 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: The operation denied a parent to pick up their children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a bouncer. The infant was removed from the bouncer and moved to a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two children with food allergies, have expired epiPens on file at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: The bus binders were observed and missing the following;  -some bus binders were missing a list for who is being transported for the month of October,  -Some bus binders were missing children's paperwork that is required for transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special School-age Permissions: The bus binders were observed and children's paperwork was missing permission for the center to transport the children to and from school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: There is a medication without a child name and it is unknown who it is for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Three children with food allergies were missing the action plans and the medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four staff files were observed missing the following training hours for the last full year;  (1)Emergency preparedness   (2)Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases,  (3)Administering medication,  (4)Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction,  (5)Understanding building and physical premises safety,   (6)Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Ten childrens files were observed and the following is missing;  Two children files are missing health care information,   One childs file is missing a special care statement,   Five children files are missing the parents received the operational policies,   One child is missing a health statement. and   Three children are missing hearing and vision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))
